what: The Round section of each dry-run brief criterion C1 names, with the whole brief's length and SHA-256; the command prints the whole brief again. Each section carries the sentence that says what blocks.
sentence: A finding blocks when it names the acceptance criterion it fails and an input the kit's writers or an author's ordinary text produce, or a leak (a copy, a broken link or a wrong pass admitted), or behavior `main` had with the probe that shows it; anything else is reported as a recorded finding.
